bias.en: Downtrend · oversold, holding $155 on heavy volume
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 超卖，放量守住 $155

read.en: Nvidia slipped 0.4% on Nov 17 to $155.46, trading $150.33–158.19 on heavy volume (1.68x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($162.9), 10-day ($173.0), 30-day ($203.0), 200-day ($203.9) and 100-day ($211.5), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($170.00), and RSI is 22.5, deeply oversold.
read.zh: 英伟达 11月17日微跌 0.4%，收于 $155.46，盘中区间 $150.33–158.19，成交放大（为 20 日均量的 1.68 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$162.9）、10 日（$173.0）、30 日（$203.0）、200 日（$203.9）和 100 日均线（$211.5）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$170.00），RSI 为 22.5，深度超卖。

read.en: The $150.33 low undercut the $155 support intraday, but the close held above it. Resistance is $156.1–158.4 (Nov 16 close, Nov 17 high, Nov 13 low), then $162.9–163.2 (5-day, Nov 13 close, Nov 16 high) and $166.2–170 (Nov 12 close, SAR). Support is $155 (Nov 16 low), then $150.3 (Nov 17 low) and $148.8. A close above $158.4 would target $163; below $150.3, $148.8.

r.en: Nov 16 close $156.14; Nov 17 high $158.19; Nov 13 low $158.39
